items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1959-12-09
items.q: That's the time I was playing music with Tom Alvors.

ctx.x: He's got... He's got... For him... Beansy. You work for him during World War II. After I first walked all my shoes out going around the WPA office and things. That's where I land that job in the Navy Yard. I'm waiting in that Navy Yard now and nothing but a baby kid. That's the time I was playing music with Tom Alvors.
